POTRAZ · Zimbabwe Telecoms

Zimbabwe ISP Tracker — Lite

No-script version. Works on any phone or browser, no JavaScript required.

This page loads with no scripts, no tracking, and almost no data. For live status maps, speed rankings and full translations, use the full interactive tracker when you have a stronger connection. Brought to you by Matokipedo.

Econet Wireless
Mobile · active mobile subscribers
Dominant mobile network operator. Holds ~73.75% of the mobile subscriber market and ~79% of mobile internet/data traffic as of Q4 2025. Subscriber base grew 8.5% in 2024.
NetOne
Mobile · active mobile subscribers
State-owned mobile operator. Grew from 4,062,894 to 4,101,492 subscribers in Q4 2025, driven by LTE/5G rural expansion — now covers 46.14% of rural base stations.
Starlink Zimbabwe
Fixed/Wireless · VSAT subscribers
Fastest-growing provider in the country. VSAT subscriptions up 31.7% quarter-on-quarter in Q4 2025 (126% average quarterly growth since Sept 2024 launch). Rapidly eating into fixed fibre traffic share.
Telecel Zimbabwe
Mobile · active mobile subscribers
Smallest of the three licensed mobile network operators, but grew subscribers 35.5% in 2024 — the fastest growth rate of any MNO that year.
Liquid (Liquid Home / ZOL)
Fixed/Wireless · no public subscriber count
Largest fixed/fibre ISP by traffic share — held ~48.4% of fixed internet traffic in Q4 2025, down from 58.9% in Q3 as Starlink took share. POTRAZ does not publish per-company subscriber counts for fixed IAPs.
Dandemutande
Fixed/Wireless · no public subscriber count
Second-largest fixed ISP by traffic share, gaining fast — up 4.47 percentage points to 17.71% of fixed internet traffic in Q4 2025.
TelOne
Fixed/Wireless · national fixed telephone lines (proxy)
State-owned fixed-line and DSL/fibre operator. National fixed telephone lines totalled 298,047 as of Q4 2024 (declining ~3.75% y/y as VoIP substitutes). Broadband subscriber count isn't disclosed separately.
Africom
Fixed/Wireless · no public subscriber count
Licensed Internet Access Provider offering fibre and corporate connectivity. No individual subscriber or traffic-share figures published by POTRAZ.
PowerTel
Fixed/Wireless · no public subscriber count
Zesa-owned IAP, primarily provides backhaul capacity and some retail fixed/wireless connectivity. No individual subscriber figures published.
Telecontract / Utande / ZARNet
Fixed/Wireless · no public subscriber count
Smaller licensed IAPs serving regional, corporate and institutional customers. Grouped here as niche players with no individually disclosed subscriber data.
